verses.gurmukhi: ੫ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ
verses.translit_en: 5 : gurmukhaa(n) dhe sukh fal dhee vaddiaaiee

en.bdb: Grandeur of the pleasure -fruit of gurmukhs

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਲਖ ਕਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: charan saran jis lakhamee lakh kalaa hoi lakhee na jaiee|

en.bdb: Lakhs of invisible powers adorn the shelter of the feet of goddess of wealth (Laksmi);

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh sabh goleeaa(n) saadhik sidh rahe lapaTaiee|

en.bdb: All prosperities, miraculous powers and treasures are her servants and many an accomplished person is engrossed in her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਉ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa jatee satee nau naath nivaiee|

en.bdb: All the four vamas, six philosophies, celebates, suttees and nine maths have been made to bow by her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਅ ਚੌਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ti(n)n loa chauadheh bhavan jal thal maheeal chhal kar chhaiee|

en.bdb: Deceptively she is pervading all the three worlds, fourteen abodes, land, sea and the nether worlds.
That goddess Kamala (Laksmi) alongwith her husband (Visnu) seeks the shelter of holy congregation

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai na aap ganaiee|

en.bdb: Wherein the gurmukhs bowing at the feet of holy persons have lost their ego and still have kept themselves unnoticed.
The grandeur of the pleasure-fruit of the gurmukhs is very great.
